offerings.name: Reader API (s.jina.ai) — Search the web and convert results to LLM-friendly text block
offerings.pricing: Token-based: Prototype Development 10亿 tokens $50 (0.050 / 1M tokens)；Production Deployment 11B tokens $500 (0.045 / 1M tokens)；『Every request costs a fixed number of tokens, starting from 10,000 tokens』
offerings.price_basis: 按 token 计费，基础档 Prototype 0.050/1M tokens；每次搜索消耗 token 起步 10,000 且可能浮动，无法精确换算每千次价格
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens; Toy Experiment 10 Million tokens, non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC)
offerings.output_type: Web search + SERP：『search the web and return the top five results with their URLs and contents, each in clean, LLM-friendly text』；JSON 返回五个条目，各含 URL、title、content、timestamp
offerings.note: 速率限制：无 key 100 RPM，Free key 100 RPM，Premium key 1000 RPM；平均延迟 2.5s。新定价模型 2025-05-06 生效，之前 auto-recharge 用户按旧价继续。
